facts.claim: The national Australian Mathematics Competition began in 1978. Early Primary (Years 1–2) becomes a standard division in 2027.
Dedicated primary papers have run for over twenty years. This is deliberately not a claim about the first primary-aged participant.
facts.source_discrepancy: The AMT retrospective says primary divisions began in 2002. Former executive director Peter Taylor records the primary committee forming in 2003 and the first primary AMC in 2004; the first AMT primary compilation covers 2004–2008. The narration uses the supported shared statement rather than an unresolved exact year.

facts.claim: The Mathematical Association of Western Australia was founded in 1958.
MAWA’s Problem Solving Program was developed in 1992. It develops problem-solving skills and clear, logical presentation of solutions.

Rossmoyne’s Honours Mathematics programme is selective entry, with applicants in Year 6. Students explore mathematics beyond the usual curriculum, join collaborative Fermat Club activities and have an AMC training camp.

editorial_notes: No score guarantees, unofficial award thresholds or unannounced future application dates.
MAWA PSP is a programme with application problems, not conflated with PEAC or a timed AMC-style exam.
The last-digit cycle and mutilated-board demonstration illustrate general mathematical ideas; neither reproduces an identified past exam question.
Kokoro bm_george, a British male voice, at 0.88 speed. MAWA is explicitly supplied as the phonemes mˈɑːwə, with possessive z where required.
